column1: # Polish (pl) catalog. Same format as `es.tsv`: context <TAB> source <TAB> translation.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# Polish video-editing vocabulary. No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI
# was consulted or copied; add entries the same way. Drafted with AI assistance; not yet reviewed by
# a native speaker. Commands use the imperative ("Otwórz projekt…"), menus and panels are nouns.
# Product, format and feature names (FilmCraft, ArtCraft, Lumetri, ProRes, EDL, AAF…) keep their
# spelling. Counts are written count-neutral ("Klipy: {n}") so every Polish number reads right.
# Terms: track = ścieżka, bin = kosz, marker = znacznik, playhead = głowica, In/Out = punkt
# wejścia/wyjścia, transition = przejście, frame hold = stopklatka, clip = klip, sequence =
# sekwencja, panel = panel, workspace = obszar roboczy, keyframe = klatka kluczowa, caption = napis,
# preferences = preferencje. Edit types keep their established names (ripple, roll, slip, slide).
